patches.name: P01
patches.notes: P01 ranks #1 of 12 by criticality (S = 0.973): removing it lowers IIC by 97.3%. It holds 178.0 ha, 70.3% of mapped habitat (#1 by area). It maintains 2 links to P12 (1.7 km), P03 (3.0 km). Alternative routes exist around it; the network stays in 7 components. Segmentation confidence for this patch is 99%.

patches.name: P02
patches.notes: P02 ranks #5 of 12 by criticality (S = 0.010): removing it lowers IIC by 1.0%. It holds 18.1 ha, 7.2% of mapped habitat (#2 by area). It is large but structurally redundant: other patches carry its links. It maintains 1 link to P11 (2.1 km). Alternative routes exist around it; the network stays in 7 components. Segmentation confidence for this patch is 98%.

patches.name: P03
patches.notes: P03 ranks #2 of 12 by criticality (S = 0.103): removing it lowers IIC by 10.3%. It holds 16.3 ha, 6.4% of mapped habitat (#3 by area). It is a cut vertex (bridge patch): its removal splits the network from 7 to 8 components. Segmentation confidence for this patch is 99%.
